test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: VAGL is related to PUAF in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, XCIN is related to RWCH. To which of the following options is FKQV related. following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**VAGL → PUAF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fafc7c2f7ef6f3b17decbae264975c547e3dd863b46db34d0a8b8b886cd6005.png] 

**XCIN → RWCH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c20ec3e4f95e299a9c3fac26d643177a4ab73a83f40aa1fdf701025ccad19a93.png] 

**Applying the same logic to FKQV:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30a8686f8247f14881b999ebba7b2f04dfee41770e6b702c310391527be117d.png] 

The resulting word is ZEKP.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
